arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Bopp argued the case involves a fundamental First Amendment question.
He stated the government cannot shield lawmakers from grassroots lobbying.
General Clement noted the Court upheld title II definitions in McConnell.
Justice Souter expressed a problem with the side that brought the case's argument structure.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the scope of electioneering communication rules. the sides that brought the case argue these rules infringe on free speech. The agency argues the rules prevent corporate influence on elections.

paragraphs: the sides that brought the case want to air ads about congressional votes without penalty.
The agency wants to enforce bans on ads it deems electioneering communications.
